intro: Team Plasma will set your Pokemon free!
Hand over your Pokemon, in the name of Team Plasma!
player_won: Your bond with your Pokemon... it's real?
Team Plasma will remember this!
player_lost: Now your Pokemon can be free!

unova_juniper_intro: Professor Juniper: Oh! You're here at last.
Welcome to the world of Pokémon! I'm Professor Juniper.
I study Pokémon — creatures that live alongside people.
Your friend {rival_name} and {friend_name} have been eager to start.
Inside this case are three Pokémon. Choose one. Your adventure begins now.
unova_juniper_starter: Take good care of your new partner.
Here is your Pokédex — it records every Pokémon you encounter.
And take these Poké Balls to catch wild Pokémon.
You received a Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls!
unova_juniper_congrats: Professor Juniper: You're the Unova Champion!
I knew from the moment you picked up that first Pokémon.
You've seen more of Unova — and more of yourself — than anyone.
Here is an upgraded Pokédex with the National mode enabled.
unova_cheren_first_battle: {rival_name}: Hey, {player_name}! I opened the Professor's case early.
I've already picked my Pokémon. Now let's see what you've got!
The strongest trainer becomes Champion — that's the goal. Don't forget it.
unova_cheren_rival_won: {rival_name}: Tch. You got stronger since last time.
That's fine. It just means I need to work harder.
I'll catch up. Count on it.
unova_cheren_rival_lost: {rival_name}: Yes! That's the result of my training!
Keep up — I won't wait for you.
unova_cheren_victory_road: This is the last time I'll battle you before the League.
Show me everything. Because I'm going to show you everything I've become.
unova_bianca_first_meet: {friend_name}: Oh! {player_name}! I'm so glad you came!
Professor Juniper let me pick first — I hope that's okay!
I'm a little nervous, but... let's do our best together, okay?
unova_bianca_won: I got a little flustered when your Pokémon used that move!
But that's okay! I learned from it. That's what battles are for!
unova_bianca_nimbasa: {friend_name}: Oh — {player_name}! Fancy meeting you in the big city!
I've been battling everyone I can find. I'm getting better, I know it!
Even if I lose, the journey means something. Right? Right!
Let's battle! I want to see how far I've come!
unova_bianca_surf: {friend_name}: Ah, {player_name}! Professor Juniper said to find you.
She wanted me to give you this — the HM Surf!
Your Pokémon can now cross water. Be careful out there!
unova_n_accumula_speech: N: Pokémon and people are... different. Is it right to keep them captive?
I can hear their voices. Pokémon speak to me.
They say they are tired of being used as tools for human ambition.
My dream is a world where Pokémon and people live separately — truly free.
I wonder... what do YOUR Pokémon think of you?
unova_n_route2_battle: N: You surprised me at Accumula Town.
You spoke up. That tells me your Pokémon trust you.
I want to understand why. So let me hear your Pokémon's voice through battle.
unova_n_route2_won: N: I see. Your Pokémon's power comes from something I don't yet understand.
We will meet again, {player_name}. I'm certain of it.
unova_n_route2_lost: But perhaps your bond with your Pokémon still has room to grow.
We'll meet again. My journey continues too.
unova_n_nimbasa_ferris_wheel: N: From up here, the whole city looks so small.
People and Pokémon living together... it looks peaceful.
But is it peace, or just... habit?
I've chosen my path. I will become the hero who frees Pokémon.
And you... I think you might be the hero who opposes me.
One day we'll settle this. Until then, grow stronger.
unova_n_chargestone: N: This cave hums with energy. Pokémon born of thunder and steel.
I caught the Pokémon here before entering. Just for this battle.
You see — I release them afterward. I never keep them.
That is the difference between us.
unova_n_castle_intro: I knew you would. We were always destined to battle here.
I've called forth Zekrom — the hero of ideals.
If your truth is stronger than my ideals, prove it.
Show me the bond between you and your Pokémon!
unova_n_castle_won: N: You won. Your truth... it shone through.
I thought I knew what was right for Pokémon.
But standing here, looking at your team... maybe I was missing something.
I need to think about this. Really think.
Thank you, {player_name}. This battle... changed me.
unova_n_castle_lost: N: ...This is what I believed was right.
Pokémon and people should not be bound together.
Until you can show me otherwise — my ideal stands.
unova_ghetsis_accumula: Ghetsis: People of Unova! Hear me!
We, Team Plasma, speak for all Pokémon!
These creatures suffer under your ownership. They are enslaved!
Do the right thing. Release your Pokémon. Set them free.
Only then can a truly just world be born.
unova_ghetsis_castle_intro: Ghetsis: Hahaha. So you defeated N.
Did you think that meant anything?
N was never my goal. He was my tool. My perfect tool.
A boy who could hear Pokémon — raised to believe in liberation.
He gathered the Legendary Pokémon for me.
Now I will use that power to rule this world. With NO ONE to oppose me.
Defeat me? A child like you? Impossible. ABSOLUTELY IMPOSSIBLE!
unova_ghetsis_castle_won: How could I lose? I planned everything! EVERYTHING!
No... no, this can't be right...
Looker: Stand down, Ghetsis. It's over.
unova_plasma_grunt: Team Plasma Grunt: Pokémon liberation is justice!
We fight for the freedom of every Pokémon from human oppression!
Lord Ghetsis will create a world where only Team Plasma wields Pokémon!
unova_plasma_grunt_lost: Team Plasma Grunt: How dare you...
Team Plasma will not be stopped by a single trainer!
unova_alder_route2: Alder: Well, well. A young trainer on a journey?
I'm Alder — the Pokémon League Champion. Though I haven't been challenging lately.
My Pokémon... they remind me that every battle is precious.
If you make it to the League, come find me. I'll be waiting.
unova_alder_champion_intro: Alder: So you made it through all four of them.
I've been watching from up here. You're something special.
I've battled many trainers across Unova — none quite like you.
Come. Show me what you and your Pokémon are made of.
unova_alder_won: You know, I lost my first Pokémon partner long ago.
For a time, I forgot why I battled.
But watching you just now... I remembered.
It's the bond. It's always been the bond.
You are the new Unova Champion — congratulations!
unova_looker_intro: Looker: I am Looker, International Police.
Team Plasma has been active across Unova — stealing Pokémon, spreading propaganda.
I am investigating their leader, Ghetsis.
If you encounter any suspicious activity... find me.
unova_looker_plasma_tip: Looker: Team Plasma's king — they call him N — is not the real threat.
Ghetsis is manipulating N from the shadows.
The boy believes in Pokémon liberation. Ghetsis believes in domination.
Whatever you do — do not let Ghetsis get his hands on a Legendary Pokémon.
unova_reshiram_encounter: The legendary Dragon of Truth awakens at the top of Dragonspiral Tower!
Its white fire burns with absolute conviction.
Reshiram — the Vast White Pokémon — has appeared!
unova_zekrom_encounter: Thunder shakes Dragonspiral Tower as the legendary Dragon of Ideals stirs!
Deep Black electricity crackles through the ancient stones.
Zekrom — the Deep Black Pokémon — has appeared!
unova_kyurem_encounter: A bone-chilling cold radiates from the Giant Chasm...
The boundary Pokémon — the one that waits at the edge of the world.
unova_cobalion_encounter: A steel-bodied Pokémon watches you from the rocky plateau.
Its gaze is sharp — judging whether you are worthy.
Cobalion, the Iron Will Pokémon, challenges you!
unova_terrakion_encounter: The ground shakes beneath enormous hooves.
Terrakion, the Cavern Pokémon — a warrior who shattered castle walls to protect Pokémon.
unova_virizion_encounter: A graceful figure steps forward from the verdant forest...
Virizion, the Grassland Pokémon — its blades are sharp as any sword.
unova_tornadus_encounter: Tornadus — the Cyclone Pokémon — descends in a torrent of wind!
unova_thundurus_encounter: Lightning splits the sky with no warning!
Thundurus — the Bolt Strike Pokémon — tears across the clouds!
unova_landorus_encounter: The earth pulses with abundant energy...
Landorus — the Abundance Pokémon — descends to judge the land's balance.
unova_victini_encounter: A warm, mysterious light fills Liberty Garden...
A small Pokémon with enormous lucky power bounces toward you!
unova_volcarona_encounter: Ancient ruins in Relic Castle deep below the sands...
A Pokémon born from ancient fire, said to have replaced the sun when it was covered in ash.
unova_museum_plasma: A Team Plasma Grunt burst from the museum holding the Dragon Skull!
Lenora: They stole the Dragonite Skull! After them — please!
Team Plasma cannot be allowed to reconstruct the ancient Dragon!
unova_plasma_nacrene_won: The Dragon Skull has been recovered!
Lenora: Thank you. This belongs to Nacrene Museum — and to history.
That Pokémon Skull holds the secret of Unova's Dragon legend.
unova_castelia_sewers: Burgh: Team Plasma is hiding in the sewers beneath Castelia City.
They're using it as a base — I won't let them defile my city.
I'll handle this side. You take the other. Let's push them out!
unova_n_throne: N: This castle rose overnight. Every stone placed by Pokémon who believe in my dream.
They trust me. And I trust them.
The age of liberation begins here, {player_name}.
Become the new hero — or fall before the hero of ideals.
unova_newgame_intro: A package arrives in Nuvema Town, addressed to you and your friends.
Inside: a note from Professor Juniper and three Poké Balls.
'Choose one partner each. Your journey through Unova starts today!'
unova_mom_newstart_1: Mom: Professor Juniper's gift arrived! I'm so proud of you, {player_name}.
Mom: Go see the whole Unova region. Just call me once in a while!
unova_mom_newstart_2: Mom: Castelia City has the tallest buildings you've ever seen.
Mom: If you win enough prize money, buy me one of those famous Casteliacones!
unova_mom_newstart_3: Mom: Your father traveled Unova when he was young, too.
Mom: He always said the best adventures start with a single step out the door.
unova_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}! Our Nuvema house has a view of the ocean!
Mom: Your Sinnoh championship paid for every brick. I made sure of it.
Mom: Five regions, five homes. My scrapbook is getting heavy!
unova_mom_home_2: Mom: I visited the Castelia Gym yesterday. Burgh painted my portrait!
Mom: I told him my child is a champion. He painted a crown on me, too.
unova_mom_home_3: Mom: The neighbors asked how a family can own houses in five regions.
Mom: I told them: 'Math homework.' They didn't believe me.
unova_cheren_house: {rival_name}'s Mom: {rival_name} is studying the Trainer handbook again.
{rival_name}'s Mom: He says he'll be the strongest trainer in Unova. I believe him!

boss.name: Cresselia
lines: Cresselia appears!
Marlon: The Champion's here? Let's ride the waves together!

player_won: Marlon: You're strong as a tidal wave!

boss.name: Heatran
lines: Heatran appears!
Cheren has opened a Gym in Aspertia City. 'A Champion visiting my Gym? Let's see how I measure up!'

player_won: Cheren: Ha. I'm proud to have lost to you.

lines: Roxie: You're the Champion? Then let's make some noise!

player_won: Roxie: Whoa, what a show! You rock!

intro: Hey {player_name}! I opened Juniper's case! My Pokémon is ready — are you?
player_won: Tch. You already beat me. Fine. I'll catch up.
player_lost: Ha! I'm the stronger trainer already. Now let's go see the Professor.

intro: Bianca: Welcome home, Champion! I've been training the whole time. Battle me!
player_won: Bianca: Hehe, you're still the best!
player_lost: Better luck next time!

intro: Gym Leader: Welcome to Striaton Gym!
One of us will face you — the one whose type counters your starter!
We are Cilan, Chili, and Cress — and together we serve the finest battles in Unova!
player_won: Gym Leader: Magnificent! You've earned the Trio Badge!
With it, Pokémon up to a certain level will obey you.
Take this TM as well — a gift from the three of us!
player_lost: Gym Leader: The type advantage was decisive today.
Come back once you've trained more. We'll be here.

requirements.fail_text: The Striaton Gym is open — find the Elemental Monkey in the Dreamyard first for a type advantage!

intro: Cheren: Before the Gym, let's see how our Pokémon have grown.
player_won: Cheren: I see. I need to think this through.
player_lost: Better luck next time!

intro: Lenora: Welcome to my gym — and my library!
I'm Lenora, the Nacrene Gym Leader.
I'm a Normal-type user. Don't underestimate what Normal can do!
player_won: Lenora: You're the real deal! Congratulations on the Basic Badge!
Take this HM Strength too — you'll need it in your travels.
Take this Cover Fossil too. The fossil lab in Nacrene City can revive it!
player_lost: Lenora: You'll need to dig deeper than that!
Come back when you've trained more. My library is always open.

requirements.fail_text: Lenora is preparing for battle at the Nacrene Museum. Earn the Trio Badge first.

intro: We have the Dragon Skull! Team Plasma's plan is unstoppable!
player_won: The skull... we've lost it. Lord Ghetsis will be furious!
player_lost: Team Plasma serves a higher justice than your victories!

intro: N: Your Pokémon... I want to hear them speak. Battle me.
player_won: N: They said they like you. How strange.

intro: Burgh: This gym is my canvas, and this battle — our masterpiece!
I'm Burgh, the Castelia Gym Leader.
Bug-types have a delicate beauty, but don't mistake that for weakness!
player_won: Burgh: Sublime! You've earned the Insect Badge!
Here — take this TM. Use it as you see fit. Create something beautiful!
player_lost: Burgh: Not quite the composition I hoped to see.
Return when your moves flow with more intention.

requirements.fail_text: Burgh is helping chase Team Plasma from Castelia's sewers. Clear the sewers first!

travel_options.message: The ferry leaves Castelia's pier for the colorful Decolore Islands.

intro: Elesa: Welcome to the stage. I'm Elesa — model and Gym Leader.
Electric-types are fast, flashy, and relentless.
Don't blink. This battle moves at the speed of lightning.
player_won: Elesa: You were faster than my Emolga. That's the Bolt Badge.
Here — take this. Bianca's father was blocking Route 5.
I called him off. You're free to head to Driftveil.
player_lost: Elesa: Speed and accuracy — that's all it takes.
Come back when you've sharpened both.

requirements.fail_text: Elesa is on the runway. Earn three badges to challenge the Nimbasa Gym!

travel_options.message: The train heads out across the plains to Anville Town.

intro: Clay: Y'all came a long way to challenge me, huh?
I'm Clay. I dug this whole city outta the ground.
Ground-types are tough as the earth itself. Let's see if you can shake 'em!
player_won: Clay: Not bad at all! You've got the Quake Badge, kid.
Now get outta my gym and go challenge the rest of the world!
Take this Plume Fossil too. The fossil lab in Nacrene City can revive it!
player_lost: Clay: The earth don't move for just anyone.
Come back when you've got more dig in you.

requirements.fail_text: Clay is chasing Team Plasma in the Relic Castle. Help him first!

intro: Bianca: My dad wanted me to go home... but I'm not giving up! Battle!
player_won: Bianca: I'm going to keep traveling. I've decided!
player_lost: Better luck next time!

intro: Skyla: Hi! I'm Skyla — pilot and Gym Leader!
I use Flying-types. They're free spirits, just like the sky.
Let's have a high-flying battle!
player_won: Skyla: Wow, you really know how to keep pace! Here's the Jet Badge!
And take this HM — it lets your Pokémon use Fly between towns!
player_lost: Skyla: Flying-types soar above most strategies!
Train more and come back — the sky is always open.

requirements.fail_text: Skyla is running the airstrip. Earn the Quake Badge first.

intro: Brycen: I am Brycen. I was once a film star — now I am a Gym Leader.
Ice-types embody discipline and stillness.
Strike with precision.
player_won: Brycen: You move with purpose. Well done. Accept the Freeze Badge.
Now go — Dragonspiral Tower needs your attention.
player_lost: Brycen: Discipline. You need more of it.
Return when your movements are as clean as ice.

requirements.fail_text: Brycen has rushed to Dragonspiral Tower — Team Plasma is there! Chase them first.

intro: N: This tower holds the hero's Dragon. My path leads here. Don't try to stop me.
player_won: N: You... you stopped me again. But Zekrom heard my call. We'll meet again.
player_lost: N: The Dragon of Ideals has chosen me. The hero of truth must still rise.

intro: Drayden: Welcome. I am Drayden, the Opelucid Gym Leader.
I use Dragon-types — the most powerful type in existence.
If you can stand before my dragons, you can stand before anything.
player_won: Drayden: You've earned this — the Legend Badge.
The road to the Pokémon League lies north.
Go. Discover the truth of Unova.
player_lost: Drayden: Dragon-types are unforgiving.
Come back stronger. The legend is still yours to write.

requirements.fail_text: Drayden is waiting — earn seven badges before challenging the Opelucid Gym.

intro: Shauntal: Oh! A challenger! I'm writing a novel about powerful trainers.
May I use our battle as inspiration?
Ghost-types are experts at writing the perfect ending!
player_won: Shauntal: Wonderful! This will make a brilliant chapter!
player_lost: Shauntal: The Ghost-type ending. A classic.

intro: Marshal: The strength of body and mind — that is Fighting-type mastery.
Show me what you're made of!
player_won: Marshal: You have both strength and focus. I acknowledge you!
player_lost: Marshal: Your spirit fights, but your body must follow.

intro: Grimsley: Winning and losing are two sides of the same coin.
I don't care which side you land on — as long as the battle is interesting.
player_won: Grimsley: Ha. You called my bluff. Well played.
player_lost: Grimsley: When you gamble, you must be prepared to lose everything.

intro: Caitlin: I've been waiting... for a trainer worthy of a proper challenge.
I am Caitlin. I hope you don't disappoint me.
Psychic-types see through everything — even your strategy.
player_won: Caitlin: You saw through my Pokémon too. Congratulations.
player_lost: Caitlin: I saw every move before you made it.

intro: Alder: So. You've come.
I've been up here thinking... about what Pokémon battles mean.
And then you walk in — eyes full of conviction.
I used to have that look too. Before I lost my partner.
Show me that your bond can still reach that place.
Come. Let this be the battle I remember.
player_won: Alder: Ha! Ha ha ha!
You've done it. You're the new Unova Champion.
But — wait. What's that roaring from outside?
N's Castle is rising! The battle isn't over yet, Champion.
player_lost: Alder: The bond is there — but it needs more time.
Come back. I'll be here whenever you're ready.

requirements.fail_text: You need all 8 Unova Gym Badges to challenge the Pokémon League.

lines: Iris: I'm Iris! Alder said someday I'd be Champion. Show me your strength!

player_won: Iris: Wow! You're incredible!

Looker: Stand down, Ghetsis. International Police — it's over.
You received the MASTER BALL!
player_lost: Ghetsis: Pathetic. Not even worthy of witnessing my new world.

player_won: Bianca: Aww, I lost! You're really good!

boss.name: Black Fog
lines: The air turns ice-cold. A black fog pours across the floor...
Two huge eyes open in the dark. A giant Haunter rises: the Black Fog!
Long ago people worshipped it as a god. It feeds on dreams. Don't let it get yours!
won: The Black Fog is too proud to ever be caught.
It Self-Destructs in a burst of black mist... and is gone.
But a cold whisper lingers: it will rise again in another haunted place.

lines: The lab is empty. A note on the desk reads:
"Genesect capsules moved to Torom Island, Decolore. Drives to follow."

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: First Pokémon, First Step
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Juniper has three starter Pokémon for you and your friends. Head to her lab in Nuvema Town and choose your partner!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trio Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge one of the Striaton Gym's three leaders. Visit the Dreamyard first to find a Pokémon with a type advantage!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Basic Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head to Nacrene City and challenge Lenora, the Normal-type Gym Leader and museum curator.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Recover the Dragon Skull
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma stole an ancient Dragon Skull from the Nacrene Museum. Chase them through Pinwheel Forest and get it back!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Insect Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Help Burgh drive Team Plasma from Castelia's sewers, then challenge the Castelia Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Bolt Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Nimbasa City's Gym Leader Elesa uses Electric-types. She's on the runway — earn three badges to face her!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Quake Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Help Clay root out Team Plasma from the Relic Castle under the Desert Resort, then challenge the Driftveil Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Jet Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Pass through Chargestone Cave to Mistralton City and challenge Skyla, the Flying-type Gym Leader.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Freeze Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma is climbing Dragonspiral Tower! Stop them before they awaken Zekrom — then challenge Brycen at Icirrus City Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Legend Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Travel east through Routes 9 and beyond to Opelucid City. Challenge Dragon-type master Drayden to earn the Legend Badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Conquer the Unova League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With all 8 badges, head north on Route 10 to Victory Road. Face the Elite Four and Champion Alder!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: N's Castle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: After defeating Alder, N's Castle rises from the ground! Face N and his legendary Zekrom — then stop Ghetsis!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Team Plasma — Castelia Sewers
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Plasma is hiding in Castelia's sewers. Help Burgh flush them out before you can challenge the gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Team Plasma — Cold Storage
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Zinzolin of the Seven Sages is using Driftveil's Cold Storage facility. Clear it out!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Iron Will Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cobalion, the Iron Will Pokémon, is hiding in Mistralton Cave. Are you worthy of its challenge?

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Swords of Justice
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Virizion roams Route 22, and Terrakion guards Victory Road. Seek out both legendary warriors!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Kami Trio
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Tornadus and Thundurus roam Unova's wild routes in storm clouds. After calming them, Landorus appears at the Abundant Shrine.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Boundary Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Deep in the Giant Chasm near Lacunosa Town, the boundary Pokémon Kyurem waits in the cold.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ancient Sun Moth
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Deep in Relic Castle, an ancient Fire/Bug Pokémon waits — Volcarona, said to have taken the sun's place in ancient times.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: N's Dragon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: After the events of N's Castle, Zekrom (or Reshiram) remains at Dragonspiral Tower. Go claim the legendary Dragon!
